name: 2024 DPRK IT-worker revenue estimate

attribution.legal_posture: Aggregate official estimate reproduced from MSMT/2025/2; non-independent corroboration only

caveats: Keep this amount as a separate estimate alongside the same MSMT estimate and overlapping annual estimates; the sources describe distinct estimate contexts.
The USD 500–800 million figure is attributed to MSMT/2025/2; an independent PSIA estimate would require separate measurement.

statements: PSIA's 2026 outlook reproduces an official Japanese estimate chart, sourced to the October 2025 MSMT report, placing DPRK IT-technician dispatch revenue in 2024 at roughly USD 500–800 million. It contextualizes IT-worker revenue alongside other sanctions-evasion and cyber revenue streams.

sources.support: Japan's PSIA reproduces the MSMT/2025/2 estimate that DPRK IT-technician dispatch generated roughly USD 500–800 million in 2024. This is official Japanese corroboration of the MSMT estimate, not a separately measured total or an independent revenue stream
sources.locator: PDF page 42, printed page 40, chart 不正な外貨獲得活動による収入の概算（2024年）
